product: Write Lakeflow Designer results to Google Drive or SharePoint
tagline: Write Lakeflow Designer results to Google Drive or SharePoint with the Output operator.
what_it_does: Write Lakeflow Designer results to Google Drive or SharePoint with the Output operator. Each run creates or replaces a file of up to 2.75 MiB. Lakeflow Designer includes built in operators for common data preparation and transformation tasks.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
